lines.en: Oh, and guess who I invited?
Remember that guy Will Colbert from high school?
He was in Ross's class, marching band,
I mean, I was his then friend.
Honey, are you sure you're not talking about your imaginary boyfriend?
I haven't thought about him in a long time.
and he didn't have a place to go, so I invited him here.
Oh, and by the way, he's lost a bunch of weight.
I mean, he looks good, okay?
Wouldn't hurt you to say it once in a while.
